password.description: Verify your identity with your current password.
password.dialogDescription: Enter your current password and a new password.

userInfo.title: Personal Information
userInfo.nameDesc: Synced with your organization's employee roster.
userInfo.emailDesc: Contact your organization administrator if you need to change it.
userInfo.directReportPrefix: Profile updates for your direct report {{name}}
userInfo.directReportHint: Contact your organization administrator to enable team management and approval permissions.

ai.title: External AI Tools
ai.mcpDialogDesc: Paste this config into Cursor's MCP settings. If the token is hidden, replace the placeholder manually.
ai.httpWarning: Currently using HTTP. External tools require a production HTTPS URL; please contact your deployment administrator.
ai.copyFailedSelect: Copy failed. Please select and copy manually.
ai.skillHint: After generating a profile file with an external AI tool, upload and import it in AI Assistant.
ai.orgDisabled: This feature is not enabled for your organization. Contact an administrator to enable it under Settings -> External AI Tools (existing tokens can still be viewed or revoked).
ai.noEmployee: Your account has no employee identity and cannot create tokens.
ai.bullet1: Read your own profile, visible evidence, and profile change requests. Managers can also view summaries for their managed team.
ai.bullet2: Directly submit your own profile change requests; the source and client are recorded. Changes requiring approval can be withdrawn before manager review.
ai.bullet3: Regular employees cannot approve requests, and no one can approve their own. Authorized managers can submit profile review decisions within their scope via MCP.
ai.bullet4Lead: Tool guidelines require obtaining the manager's consent first.
ai.bullet4Strong: The platform does not enforce per-call verification of manager consent.
ai.bullet4Tail: Every call leaves an audit record with source and client metadata.
ai.bullet5: Collaboration, workload, extension approvals, and plan acceptance are web-only.
ai.tokenScopeNote: Tools act on your behalf with permissions limited to your account. You can revoke tokens anytime under My Tokens below.
ai.tokenNameHint: Keep your token secure. Default validity is 90 days.
ai.newTokenTitle: This token is shown only once. Copy and save it now.

clients.title: Authorized Apps
clients.description: Revoked apps must re-authorize before accessing your account.

identities.title: Jira Accounts
identities.description: Synced work records are attributed as profile evidence for the matched employee.

im.noEmployee: Your account has no employee identity and cannot bind IM accounts.
im.title: Bind Chat Account
im.description: Send the bind code to the org assistant via direct message. Do not share it with others.
im.codeHint: Valid for 10 minutes, single use only. Expires at {{expiresAt}}. Regenerating invalidates the previous code.
im.expiredHint: Inactive. Confirm the channel is enabled and bind again.
im.unboundMessage: Unbound. Previous binding and bind codes are now invalid.
im.footerNote: Re-binding is required after changing your password or switching org apps. Chat messages are stored on each platform's servers (Telegram servers are outside mainland China).

delegation.title: Review Delegation
delegation.description: Review delegation is automatically synced from your reporting line and department hierarchy. When you are the primary reviewer, all of your organizational superiors can review on your behalf under Collab -> Reviews. New requests only notify you; you will be notified if a superior reviews on your behalf.
delegation.notReviewer: Your account is not a reviewer (neither department manager nor org admin), so there are no approval duties to delegate.
delegation.noDelegates: No automatic superior delegates available (you are at the top of the reporting line and department hierarchy, or your superiors do not have active accounts yet).

oauth.disabledDesc: External tool authorization is currently disabled. External AI tools cannot connect.
oauth.invalidOrExpired: Authorization link is invalid or expired. Please restart the connection from the external tool.
oauth.requestSubtitle: The application name is self-reported. Please verify its source.
oauth.switchOrgHint: To authorize another organization, switch organizations in the sidebar first.
oauth.perm1: View your profile, related records, capability dictionary, and request status
oauth.perm2: Draft, submit, or withdraw profile update requests
oauth.perm3: Submit answers to pending questions on your behalf
oauth.dataWarningBody: Your profile and related records will be sent to this tool and its AI provider. You can withdraw any update requests it submits before manager approval.
oauth.revokeHint: You can revoke authorization anytime under Settings -> Connections & Integrations.
